title: Reconstruction from window cells
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $s$ be a natural number, let $f$ assign a cell value to each natural-number index, and let $p$ be a valid input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions. Suppose among indices $j<2s+1$, the head-and-summary slot is present exactly at $j=0$; for each work tape, at most one such index marks its head; and for each work tape, at least one such index marks its head. Then the configuration reconstructed from $f$, $s$, and $p$ has all work-tape heads within distance $s$ of the origin and blank cells outside that window, and its encoded cell at every index $j<2s+1$ is exactly $f(j)$.
